value.answer: Assuming you mean the Beckham-backed IM8 powder, I'd call it overrated for most people. It runs about $78 a month for Base and $99 for Pro, and the proprietary blends hide how much of each ingredient you're actually getting. Dietitians mostly say a healthy person eating a varied diet doesn't need this many supplements, and I couldn't find independent evidence it beats a normal diet plus a few targeted ones. Fans do love the energy and digestion, so if you enjoy it and can afford it, fine, but it isn't worth the hype.
